scope: Federal ministries and the Prime Minister's Office; provincial ministries are not included.
note: 按现行联邦职责覆盖17个部委及总理办公室；部分官网仍保留旧英文名称。网站登记不等于采集成功。
noteEn: Covers 17 federal ministry portfolios and the Prime Minister's Office. Some sites retain legacy English names. Registration is not proof of successful collection.
